title: 面试高频：GC、泄漏、OOM 与 Native 内存
key_conclusions: Strong interview answers start by defining version, device, process, memory bucket, and scenario boundaries.
GC, leaks, OOM, and Native memory should be answered as separate evidence paths, not collapsed into generic memory leak talk.
Each answer should include mechanism, observable evidence, fix strategy, validation, rollback, and version caveats.
Android 10/11 lmkd boundaries and Android 17 memory-limiter diagnostics are useful differentiators in senior-level answers.
shallow_points: The article provides answer frameworks but does not include real interview transcripts or scoring rubrics.
It does not attach real HPROF, Perfetto, heapprofd, lmkd, or ApplicationExitInfo samples.
It does not validate Android 17 MessageQueue implementation details against source.
It does not include a mock interview exercise with expected follow-up questions.
